description: Create (without sop_id) or update (with sop_id) a SOP of the user's organization. Owners/admins only. steps = ordered list of {title, body?, role?} (max 40). outpost_ids = the outposts it applies to (from list_clients; omit = all). status=archived archives it, status=active restores it. Max 10 active SOP: the 11th is refused with limit_reached. Show the user the title and steps before saving.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.

outpost_ids.description: Elenco di id outpost (seller × marketplace), array di stringhe.

sop_id.description: Omit to create a new SOP.

steps.description: Passaggi della procedura: array di stringhe in ordine.

role.description: Ruolo a cui è destinata la procedura, es. ads, listing, operations.

name: save_sop
